description: Ad-Free - No Paywall - Just Radio AMARadio was developed to enable an honest and distraction-free radio listening experience. The radio app is completely ad-free, contains no tracking, and no unnecessary bloatware. Originally started as a personal project to create a simple and accessible interface for global radio, the app remains consistently transparent and easy to use – for everyone. Key Features - 60,000 stations via Radio-Browser API - Local Radio-Browser database - Optional background sync with Radio-Browser database - Android Auto Integration - Modern Home Screen Widgets - Custom Radio Stations - Advanced Search & Filtering: Find stations by Name, Country, Language, or Tags. - Dynamic UI Scaling - Broad Language Support - Modern Design: Jetpack Compose, Dark/Light modes. - Optimized Image Loading via Coil - Sleep timer, favorites management, custom station management, and M3U export/import. Acknowledgments Special thanks to the RadioDroid project for the inspiration and ground-breaking work in open-source radio streaming.
